outcome: Odds ratio of elective and emergency caesarean section (CS)
Risk-adjusted proportions of elective and emergency CS
cohort: 226,612 singleton births by 198,590 mothers in 29 maternity units in Denmark
finding: The study found significant variation in risk-adjusted caesarean section rates between hospitals in Denmark, suggesting systematic variation in practice despite being a small, well-regulated country.
mod_finding: Breech presentation and previous CS were the main risk factors for elective CS, while breech presentation and cephalopelvic disproportion were the main risk factors for emergency CS.
